<?php
function exit_ctrl8($formal = 13) {
    declare(ticks=0);
    $formal = 99;
    $answer = 41;
    echo "BEFORE|";
    $answer = func_num_args() && exit(13);
    echo "AFTER|", (int)$answer, "|";
    return $formal;
}
$value = exit_ctrl8();
echo "RESULT|", $value, "|";

<?php
function exit_ctrl8($formal = 13) {
    declare(ticks=0);
    $formal = 99;
    $answer = 41;
    echo "BEFORE|";
    $answer = func_num_args() && exit(13);
    echo "AFTER|", (int)$answer, "|";
    return $formal;
}
$value = exit_ctrl8(3, 7);
echo "RESULT|", $value, "|";
